notes.title: Causa Beginners Tournament - March 2021
notes.content:
We’re announcing a new official, beginners-friendly Tournament of Causa, in which both new and experienced players will showcase their abilities using the advanced Pre-Built Decks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/b6244a2d87ea6ef74ac94b288831676122477ed7.png

Registration


 Free-to-join. No registration fee. 

 Available on Battlefy.

 Registration is open until Saturday, March 27th, 2021, at 2:00 pm (GMT - 3 / Chile Time).


Date: March 27th, 2021.

Times: 


 Registration: Until Saturday, March 27th, 2021, at 2:00 pm (GMT - 3 / Chile Time).

 Check-in: Registered players will need to check-in on Battlefy on March 27th, between 2 and 3 pm (GMT - 3 / Chile Time). If a player doesn’t check in, they will not be considered in the tournament. 

 The tournament starts at 3 pm (GMT - 3 / Chile Time).


Format: 


 Single Elimination Brackets: The pairings will be defined at random by Battlefy. The winner of each round advances to the next bracket, while the loser is eliminated from the tournament. 

 Best of 5: The round is won by the first player who wins 3 matches in a round.

 Ban: When the round begins, each player will ban one of the four available decks, so their opponent won’t be allowed to use this deck during the round. To win the round, a player must win a game with each of the remaining decks.

 Deck: Players will be able to choose between the 4 advanced Pre-Built Decks available in the game (except for the banned deck). The use of any other Decks will result in disqualification from the tournament. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/e5fb7c95019469f22dbf73cabe30b9794631a45f.jpg

Players may report their results in Battlefy, or in the #official_tournaments channel. In this case, the result will be added to Battlefy by an admin. 

All tournament coordinations will take place in the #official_tournaments channel of the Causa Discord Server. 


Prizes: 

1st: 
An official Causa T-shirt from the Twitch Merch Store;
2 Card Packs and 400 Organite; 
Special “Champion” Title (in-game & Discord).

2nd: 2 Card Packs and 400 Organite

Semi-finalists: 1 Card Pack and 300 Organite

Giveaway: All participants who play at least one match will get an entry to the giveaway of a Card Back of their choice from the game’s Market.   

The winner of the 1st place will be awarded points towards the annual Causa Championship Series event. Details about this will be revealed soon!

Prizes will be assigned to the account specified by each participant.  

Conflict Resolution

The main goal is to have fun, and foster a friendly community.All players are expected to play fair, and solve their disagreements amicably. 

We recommend taking screenshots of the victories to clarify the results. If a match is interrupted due to a critical bug, or connection issue, it is up to both players to decide if repeating the game. 

If a disagreement persists, the organizers may act as judges. 

Questions

All coordination, player support, etc., will take place in the #official_tournaments channel in the Causa Discord.  

For further assistance, please contact Hakkon#4166.

notes.title: Meet Helemir, the new Leader of Wealth
notes.content:
Hey, 

While we deep-dive into the development of the Ranked Mode, we're back this week with an exciting new update. 

This time, we're glad to announce that Helemir, King of Rovalia is the new Leader of Wealth in Causa, Voices of the Dusk. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/66aaac39a1a1a2d8630dc54611c09873a6d39a7d.png

Details about the background of this character have been revealed: 

"Helemir was the rightful heir to the Crown until the late Empress changed the laws of succession. Fearing the temper of the soon-to-be king, the Council swiflty approved the new system based on merit, leaving behind the succession by mere inheritance.

For many, Helemir is a careless aristocrat, completely indifferent to the needs of the people. Nevertheless, he certainly knows who to please to ensure the stability of the Empire. In the midst of the crisis, the rich of Rovalia continue to support his claim to the throne, while the Council members, little by little, put a price to their favor."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/23f87f0a3c501e46f0fac3c6afe2ada7959ed9cb.jpg

Regarding Helemir’s playstyle, his Leader Decisions are unlocked when reaching Level 3, 4, and 6 of Cause:

At Level 3, 

 Prepare: Add two Noble Privileges to your Hand; or
 Summon: Invoke an Astarian Noble. 


At Level 4, 

 Inheritance: Gather 3, then draw three cards; or 
 Prepare +: Add a Rovalian Aristocrat to your Hand and gain +1 play for the turn.


At Level 6,

 Summon: Invoke two Rovalian Guards; or 
 Summon: Invoke an Rovalian Lord.


Here are the details of the aforementioned cards: 


 Noble Privileges: Lvl 2 | Event | Draw a card, then Gather 1 and gain +1 Play for the turn.
 Rovalian Guard: Lvl 3 | Mercenary | 2/3 | Vigilant. If you have three or more cards in Hand at the end of your turn, gain +1 Attack.
 Rovalian Lord: Lvl 6 | Aristocrat | 2/5 | Initiative: Gain +1 Attack for each card in your Hand.


Also, a new rotation of Helemir-themed cosmetic items are available in the Market! Check them out, and pick your favorites. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/8858bf7a80b8e7ad9859faaf9d904f6ae1a471cc.png

Here are the Patch Notes 1.0.8: 


 New Leader of Wealth: Helemir, King of Rovalia. A new free Pre-Built Deck for this Leader is included in the game. 
 Uko’s Leader Decisions were re-designed. “Trade” changed to Level 6 instead of Level 3, replacing “Disuade +”. The new Decision at Level 3 is “Summon: Invoke a Silk Merchant.” 
 Deneria’s Leader Decisions were re-designed. New Levels were assigned to “Politics” and “Disuade +.” 
 New content was included in the Market. Available for both Organite and Gold. 
 New Pre-Built Decks were added to the game. 
 The visual effect of the Attack of Rogue Characters was corrected. 
 The videos of Backgrounds and Leaders were optimized.
 

We'd like to congratulate the winners of the Causa Colegio de Hibernalia Community Tournament:  krystalliquide, Galgara, and Blessed Player. Our next events are announced on the #tournaments channel on the Causa Discord Server. 

Also, a HUGE shout-out the 50 Founders who have supported the Cause so far by purchasing the Founders Soulember Bundle available in the Causa Website. To celebrate, we're giving away a 5-Card Pack and 750 Organite Bundle on the #freebies channel. Be sure to react to the post to enter! 

We hope you enjoy this update! We can't wait to hear your feedback.

notes.title: A new Leader of Glory has been revealed
notes.content:
Hey all! 

This week we’re very glad to be back with an exciting announcement: 

Eudala, The Returned has been added to Causa as a new Leader of Glory. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/1f423b17d29e6e8e6c4a1a0d649faf4b63520630.png

Eudala is a Survivor who already had an appearance during the first Campaign in the game, when she joined the General of Elyr on her quest against the Dusk and the Invasion of the Empire. Now, more details about the background of this character have been added to the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/fe05a22756b4a073b713a5d2914763edcd4d09e8.jpg

Regarding this character’s playstyle, her Leader Decisions are unlocked when reaching Level 3, 5, and 6 of Cause. Make your choices:

At Level 3, 

 Summon: Invoke a Pale Renegade; or 
 Summon & Prepare: Invoke a Suffering Ashenshoul for each Leader, and add an Arcane Defense to your hand. 


At Level 5, 

 Survival: Change your Health to 10, then Gather 4, and obtain +1 Play this turn; or 
 Obtain: Invoke a Xetorati Spear.


At Level 6,

 Prepare: Add a Tenacious Defence to your hand; or 
 Summon: Invoke two Pale Renegades, and then your Opponent Invokes a Suffering Ashensoul. 


Here are the details of the aforementioned cards: 


 Pale Renegade: Lvl 3 | Survivor | 2/4 | While your Health is 10 or less, has +2 Attack and Vigilant.

 Suffering Ashensoul: Lvl 1 | Duskling | 1/4 | Ashensoul.

 Arcane Defense: Destroy a Support, then Deal 2 Damage to All Ashensouls.


Thanks to her synergy with the Characters of the Survivor archetype, Eudala brings consistency and a fresh new approach to the Glory strategy.

Also, a new rotation of cosmetic items are available in the Market! Check them out, and pick your favorites!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/92ddcaa4dc057ced882e64fa0b4abbfb18190b97.png

We keep updating Causa every week! Stay tuned to all news, claim your freebies, and get involved in the development by joining our Discord Server.  

We hope you enjoy this update! Have a wonderful rest of the week.

notes.title: New skill, mission timers, optimization, and more in Causa Update 1.0.7.
notes.content:
As every week, a new update of Causa is available! Read the details of the Patch Notes 1.0.7 below: 


 The server was upgraded. 

 We added a timer to indicate when the next Daily and Weekly Missions will be assigned.

 We added a timer to indicate when the player will be able to replace a Mission. 

 The keyword Aggressive was removed. 

 The keyword Rush was added: It may Attack enemy Characters the turn in enters into play.

 The assets of gameplay effects were optimized. 

 Minor game updates: The art of the “Organite Expert” was updated, and the Leader Decision of Fadun is now called “Elyrian Forge” instead of “Talarian Tools”.

 The following cards were redesigned: 


Raging Soldier, from “Aggressive”, to “Rush. Initiative: Deal 1 Damage to your opponent”. 

Ashensoul Soldier, from “Aggressive. Ashensoul”, to “Rush. Ashensoul. Initiative: Deal 1 Damage to your opponent”. 

Brave Settler, from “Aggressive”, to “Rush”. Green Razorback, from “Vigilant. Aggressive”, to “Vigilant. Rush”. 

Vile Zealot, from “Aggressive. Initiative: Deal 1 Damage to all Leaders”, to “Initiative: Deal 2 Damage to All Leaders”. 

Furious Charge, from granting “Aggressive”, to grant “Rush”. Lenician Brawler, from “Expend 2”, to “Expend 1”. 

Sabotage Contract, from “Expend 2”, to “Expend 1”. 

Grotty Tavern, from “At the start of your turn, Heal 1 to your Mercenaries and give them +1 Attack”, to “When you play a Mercenary, give it +1 Attack and Gather 1”. 

Battle, from “Destroy All Characters with Attack 1 or less, then give +1 Attack to your Characters”, to “Deal 2 Damage to All Characters with Attack 1 or less, then give +1 Attack to your Characters”.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/d6fd70b6406f37cf42bac082733d3e77e63e6615.jpg

We're just one Founders Soulember Bundle away from unlocking a free avatar for everyone, so make sure to join the Causa Discord Server to be aware of this awesome moment. Also, the design of the upcoming Ranked Mode is being discussed, so it's a great time to join the chat!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2, and Special Early Access Bundle Announced
notes.content:
It's been 2 amazing weeks of Early Access! Thank you very much for playing Causa, as well as for all your support and feedback.

There's still a LONG WAY to go to keep improving the game, but so far we're very glad we have reached over 2,000 new players accounts, and 124 user reviews, with an overall Very Positive score. We've also gathered TONS of constructive feedback through the Steam Community Hub and the Causa Discord Server.

We wanted to let you know we've just released an update that includes significant changes in the game balance. Here's the details of the version 1.0.2: 


 We increased the odds of obtaining Legendary Cards, from 1% to 1.7%.

 The difficulty of the Daily Missions was lowered, so they are easier to accomplish. 

 To foster the PvP Mode, vs IA now grants 25% of the experience granted by PvP matches, instead of 50%.

 "Fatigue" is now called "Despair", to fit the lore of Causa better.

 We changed the Level of the Leader's Decisions: Uko, from 2-3-5 to 2-3-6; Bara, from 2-3-4 to 2-3-5; Nilset, from 2-3-6 to 2-4-6; Danu, from 2-3-6 to 2-4-6; and Ralkán, from 2-5-6 to 2-4-6.

 We changed the Black Market Agent skill, from “When you draw a card due to an effect, deal 1 Damage to your opponent”, to “At the end of each turn, if you control two or more Supports, your opponent Expends 1”. Note: We loved the suggestion of adding the hitting himself effect. So we'll design a new card from another archetype to do that. This change should help the Milling Wealth strategies.

 We changed the War Drums from: Level 6, 1 Use, “Use: Give +1 Attack and Aggressive to your Characters”, to Level 5, No Uses, “Your Characters have +1 Attack”.

 The following cards were nerfed: Desert Blade (Gains +3 Attack instead of +4); Barcajali Brute (Health 4 instead of 5); Officiant of the Flame (Health 2 instead of 3); Intimidation (Level 4 instead of 3); Sumkala Disciple (Health 2 instead of 3); Official Safe-Conduct (Level 3 instead of 2); Sister of Mourne (Health 4 instead of 5); Grotty Tavern (Level 6 instead of 4).

 The following cards were buffed: Highway Assault (Expends 1 instead of 2); Envoy of Ciadel (Level 4 instead of 5).

 We fixed the bug that enables the Ranked button after leaving the Campaign Section. 

 We added the "Repeat e-mail" and "Repeat password" fields in the Registration, to avoid issues when registering new accounts. 


Regarding what we'll be working on next, a few days ago we asked the community on Twitter what features/modes they're looking forward to the most, and what they think should be added to the game first. The results were the following: 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/c4e099e92903cb6c8853eabf01678bbf6d6a451d.jpg


However, the discussion on Twitter and Discord was even more enlightening than the voting itself. We'll let you know how all this impacts our development plans very soon!

Apart from the upcoming features, our current top priority is to improve the game stability, and fix connection/matchmaking issues. If you encounter any problem on this area, please share the details with us. This will help us identify and solve the problem.

Finally, alongisde the free codes and rewards we've announced so far - which you may find on the #freebies channel of our Discord Server -, today we're also revealing a new Early Access Bundle available for purchase on our official website: the Founders Soulember! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/def96246051deda9e14b3bf98a1db1d991602506.jpg


This is a special, limited-stock offer aimed for the Early Access players who'd like to support the development of Causa and its community. For USD $60, this bundles includes: 

 50 Card Packs. 
 3,500 Organite.
 1 Exclusive Founders Soulember Card Back
 1 Exclusive Founders Soulember Banner
 2 Exclusive Titles: Founder, and Dawnbringer  
 10 Avatars (see image below)
 Sponsor 1 Free Card Pack for everyone during 2 weeks! 


That's right! We'll create a unique Card Pack code highlighting your username, to be included among the other freebies available for everyone on our Discord during a 2-week period. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/86d907564854ee79bf3898ab981ffac7c071bbe9.png


We hope to be back with more updates and surprises soon! If you have any questions or feedback, please reach out to us on Discord, and the Steam Community Hub.

Have wonderful rest of the week!

notes.title: Free Soulember to craft up to 10 Legendary Cards, and Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing Causa and for all your valuable feedback during this first week of Early Access! 

Today we’re presenting the Update 1.0.1 of Causa, which includes a major surprise aimed to improve your experience and progression in the game:

All users - existing and new - will be assigned free Soulember to craft up to 10 Legendary Cards. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/5c71bb1081203b55353544f853677d60b576b39b.jpg


Considering the other recent changes to the game’s economy, we expect this free Soulember to give a huge boost to your Card Collection. 

We’re also simplifying the Soulember counter, so your Soulember and all the costs are divided by 10 - this is why you’ll see 6,000 new Soulember in your account, but also 10 times cheaper costs in the Card Crafting section. 

Summing these and other changes up, here are the Patch Notes for version 1.0.1:


 Free Soulember to craft up to 10 Legendary Cards assigned to new and existing players.
 Soulember amounts simplified on the game’s client - the proportion was divided by 10, so you’ll see 6,000 new Soulember in your account, and all card crafting costs divided by 10.
 We increased the reward of the Weekly Missions from 600 to 1,000 Gold. 
 Consumed cads now produce more Soulember - a total of one third of their original value. 
 We added a clear timer per turn for the PVP matches.
 The visualization of the player’s experience and levels was modified in the Missions and Profile sections.
 We fixed the bug that allowed Characters to be healed beyond their current maximum Resistance, even though it was previously set to an specific value by an effect.
 We fixed the bug that prevented players from finding casual matches after playing a Custom match.


We look forward to your feedback to keep improving the game. If you like, you may join us on the official Causa Discord, and leave us your comments and questions on the Steam Community Hub, 

We hope you enjoy the game! Have a wonderful day.

notes.title: Exclusive Early Access Card Back Reveal and Small Update Notes
notes.content:
Hey, 

Thank you very much for playing Causa and for all your valuable feedback during these first days of Early Access. We’re very glad about the reception of the game so far.

Today, we have an important reveal! Here’s the Special Early Access Card Back: Founders Organite - a cool item you’ll be able to get exclusively by playing during the Early Access of Causa. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/4e87f1486212c00c89523c770d7a51b7f292fb8c.png


This special item will be given to all Causa players who get to Level 10 on all the four powers in Causa: Glory, Wealth, Influence, and Spirit. 

To claim this reward, you just need to share a screenshot of your achievement on the #founders-rewards channel of the official Causa Discord server. The dev team will get back to you with this exclusive reward through DM. 

We'd also like to announce the creation of the #freebies channel on our Discord server, in which you'll be able to check the currently available codes to redeem for free gifts in-game. A great opportunity to boost your collection with free card packs and more! 

Additionally, considering all your feedback, we've made a small update, with some changes in the game economy to improve your progression in Causa: 

 The rewards for the daily, weekly, and level missions have been improved. 
 The reward for each Victory in PvP matches has been upgraded from 15 to 25.
 Consumed cards now produce more Soulember, which accelerates the possibilities of card crafting: 
Common: from 20 to 30 Soulember. 
Rare: from 80 to 150 Soulember. 
Epic: from 500 to 750 Soulember 
Legendary: from 2,000 to 2,500 Soulember
 Crafting Legendary Cards is now cheaper. It takes 6,000 instead of 6,500 Soulember. 
 Cosmetic items are now only available for Organite. 


We also included some technical improvements and bug fixing: 

 Small change to the Consume and Create buttons in the Card Crafting Menu. There's no need to hold the button to Create and Consume. You can cancel the process by clicking again while it loads.
 The bug that caused a problem with how the pages of the Collection were displayed was corrected. 
 The Glossary was corrected: now it is displayed on different languages, and only the current keywords.
 We implemented a temporary solution for the bug that causes a card from your hand to be stuck on your cursor. Please press Alt + tab to change the window, and then come back to the game; or click outside the window and come back to the game (for windowed mode).
 A small graphic change: the amounts of Gold and Organite needed to buy Card Packs is outside the Purchase button.


We're still organizing all your feedback, and will be attentive to everything you can tell us during the coming days. We’ll start sharing patch notes from now on! 

Don’t forget to join the official Causa Discord or leave us your feedback on the Causa Steam Community Hub. 

We hope you enjoy the game! Have a wonderful week.

notes.title: Dev Update | March 2020: Here's what we've been working on.
notes.content:
Hey! We hope you’re doing great during these hectic times. 

On our side, we’ve been eager to share with you the details about our progress during the last stage of development of the strategy card game Causa, Voices the Dusk. As you may know, big news are on the way!

As is often the case in game development, during the final stages of a project programmers tend to have multiple tasks to fulfill. This is why during the past few weeks our team has been focusing on optimizing the game, identifying and fixing bugs, implementing visual improvements, and developing a few pending features.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/03a4fd9fcd9cc6a66598aa0d4b614633fa62624f.png

For instance, our programmer Boris “Satabolik” has been implementing a redesign of the market in Causa. It will be quite different from what you experienced during the Demo Weekend last November: Card packs will only be available for purchase with Gold - the currency you gain by playing. Also, only limited amounts of Soulember - the material used in card crafting - will be available for purchase. With these changes, we’re aiming to give players more control over the content they acquire, and therefore avoid any Pay2Win element in the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/a6c83016789b36b39618bf8a0fb1049e00b15ddb.jpg

In terms of game design and script writing, during the past few weeks we’ve been working on designing and implementing Causa’s second Campaign. Our goal is to offer at least two campaigns, with seven playable episodes each, when Causa finally goes live. 

Alongside this, we’re currently polishing the flavor texts that will accompany each Leader, card, and gameplay background. These are extremely important elements to present the vast and exotic fantasy setting in which the events of the game take place.  

We’ll soon resume the game balance, therefore, we’ll be working side by side with the amazing group of experienced players that have joined the adventure of developing Causa as testers. Make sure to join our official Discord server to chat with them and the rest of our team!

In the areas of art, animation, music,  and sound design, we’ve been working on adapting the assets to optimize the game, polish the details that are required to offer an overall smooth and engaging game experience, and other surprises we’ll reveal soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34935535/b1ea8cc62782790af3aab1c099ccc51c4f8532c5.jpg

Greetings from the Causa team! 

We'll soon be back with more news and updates! In the meantime, make sure to subscribe to our newsletter to learn about our latest news, and stay tuned to our social channels for more updates!  Discord | Facebook | Twitter | Instagram | Reddit | Twitch | Youtube

notes.title: The Closed Beta is over... So what comes next?
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34935535/4893a3aac499b2b40e0fe62737c613730a1805d0.jpg

On August 8th the Closed Beta of Causa, Voices of the Dusk finally ended. So, after a demo that lasted for over 2 months, the question is: what does the future hold for this new indie CCG? 

First of all, we'd like to thank everyone participated in this beta period. We reached +6.000 subscribers, and gained a lot of extremely valuable feedback, which has allowed us to keep improving the game, as well as develop the remaining features and content.

Alongside this, we truly appreciate all the interest and enthusiasm of the amazing content creators and streamers who recorded videos and streamed the game on their channels. This meant a HUGE boost of motivation for us. As a token of our appreciation, we prepared a video with a few clips we were able to collect. You may check out this video here. 

So, what comes next? At the moment we are working very hard on the final phase of development of PC version of Causa. During this period,  we'll keep sharing info and seek-peaks into the developing process, and hope to have news about the upcoming demos soon! We really look forward to keeping you involved, as your feedback has been amazing. Here's some of our plans:


 We’ll keep streaming in our official Twitch channel every Thursday at 3 PM (ET). We’ll have a chat, share details about the game, and updates about our progress.

 We’ll upload videos to our Youtube channel, focusing on the streams as well as new content about the game.

 Twitter, Facebook and Instagram will be active every day to show you updates and more details of Causa. Keep an eye on this social channels because we’ll announce limited timed-demos and other special events. 

 We’ll keep in touch with our emerging community on Discord and Reddit, so please join us and share all your suggestions and comments about the game.


Also, remember to subscribe to our newsletter to stay up-to-date and be the first to receive the most important announcements and invitations for the coming demos. 

Thanks all for this incredible experience, it was amazing to have you onboard during our Closed Beta. We are as excited and eager as you, so we'll keep working hard to complete the game!
